canonical_grade_domain.negative_clarification: The canonical TC domain is NOT defined as K in R. Real-grade completion is an ambient topological embedding, not the discrete-algebraic TC universe.

tc_definition.scaled_zeta_representation: Z_tau(s, K) = zeta(tau^{-K} * s), (s, K) in C x A_R
tc_definition.completed_xi_representation: X_tau(s, K) = xi(tau^{-K} * s), (s, K) in C x A_R
tc_definition.principle_of_redundancy: No new information does not imply no new mathematical constraint. The same zeta object is redundantly represented across infinite incommensurate scales.

grid_definition.graded_grid_L_K: L_K = { n * tau^K : n in +-N } = tau^K (Z \ {0})
grid_definition.total_universe_L_tau: L_tau = cup_{K in A_R} L_K = { n * tau^K : n in +-N, K in A_R }
grid_definition.incommensurability_theorem: L_J cap L_K = empty_set for all J != K in A_R
grid_definition.incommensurability_proof_basis: Lindemann-Weierstrass and Baker's theorems: tau = 2*pi is transcendental, so tau^{K-J} is never rational for non-zero algebraic K - J.

zero_orbit_definition.graded_worldline: rho_K = tau^K * rho, K in A_R
zero_orbit_definition.zero_condition: Z_tau(rho_K, K) = zeta(rho) = 0 identically for all K in A_R

radial_invariant.worldline_invariance: R_tau(rho_K, K) = delta identically for all K in A_R
